conditions: The three part researches only unlock once the main Nezha research completes, so the minimum is 6 days before parts even start.
Costs shown are Ghost-clan (x1); Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30 and Moon x100 multiply every resource.
Never build a Barracks in a solo clan; it raises the tier and multiplies every research cost. Clan rank is separate and free.
bonuses: Joining an established clan that already researched him and simply buying the blueprints is the near-unanimous shortcut.

conditions: Blueprints can only be bought from your own clan's Dojo; visiting another clan's Dojo does not let you buy from their labs.
